items.title: Waldren "Frog" Joseph Interview, 1961-07-10
items.q: Freddie Coleman, Jack Willis, Sam Dutra, we've been working together off and on for about the last 23, 24 years.

ctx.x: You were on both the Cook records and that MGM, weren't you, with Freddie Coleman?
Yeah. Well matter of fact, Freddie Coleman, Jack Willis, Sam Dutra, we've been working together off and on for about the last 23, 24 years.
Really? That long was Sam too?
